treaty_name: Convention between the Government of the Republic of Estonia and the Government of the United States of America for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (1998)
eif_quote: Estonia MoF table (No. | Jurisdiction | Initialled | Signed | Ratified | In force from | Effective from | MLI effective from): 64. | United States of America | 06.06.1997 | 15.01.1998 | 21.10.1998 ( est/eng ) | 30.12.1999 | 01.01.2000 |

rates.quote: a) 5 percent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which holds directly at least 10 percent of the voting shares of the company paying the dividends;
b) 15 percent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the interest.
b) 10 percent of the gross amount of the royalties in all other cases.
a) 5 percent of the gross amount of the royalties paid for the use of industrial, commercial or scientific equipment;

ppt.quote: The United States is not a Party to the MLI; the treaty has no PPT (it has a Limitation on Benefits article, Art. 22).

notes: Dividend 10% threshold is of voting shares. RIC/REIT dividends: 5% tier not available; REIT dividends get 15% only for individuals holding <10%, otherwise domestic rate. Interest exempt at source for governments/central banks/wholly-owned financial institutions and government guaranteed/insured loans, and credit-sale interest (Art. 11(3)(a),(b)); contingent interest taxable up to the 15% portfolio dividend rate (Art. 11(3)(d)); REMIC excess inclusions per US domestic law. Limitation on Benefits (Art. 22) applies. Effective for WHT on amounts paid or credited from 2000-01-01 (Art. 28(2)(a)).
